about: Every measured claim the site shows. Each one quotes its source (a README section, a CHANGELOG line, a lab note or a benchmarks write-up) word for word; scripts/notes/build.mjs checks that the source exists, that the quote is in it, that every number shown is in the quote, and that every data file is one the release ships. Numbers are never computed or rounded here.
